synopsis: AVL's Generic Off-Road Automation System (GOAS) and off-road engineering are adapted from on-road applications for agriculture, forestry, construction and mining [f8687]. Chapter 11 and the glossary both cite tractor demonstrations, with more specific accounts identifying a retrofitted tractor [f8688, f16076, f16097]. Chapter 11 additionally describes GOAS as offering "shift-left" simulation and identifies ARTI-Robots in the retrofitted-tractor demonstration [f8800]. The supplied facts establish application scope and demonstration evidence, but provide no quantified validation results, costs or dates [f8687, f8688, f16076, f16097, f8800].

relations.note: Both cite tractor demonstrations of AVL GOAS.
Both describe a tractor demonstration; the latter specifies retrofitting.
Both identify a retrofitted-tractor demonstration; Chapter 11 adds simulation and ARTI-Robots.
The broader vendor evidence gains retrofit, simulation and collaborator details.
Chapter 11 adds retrofitting, shift-left simulation and ARTI-Robots to the glossary example.
A retrofitted-tractor demonstration provides an example of adaptation to agricultural machinery.
